sourceTitle: Guy Rivers: A Tale of Georgia
description: "Guy Rivers: A Tale of Georgia" by William Gilmore Simms is a historical novel written in the mid-19th century. It unfolds in the upper part of Georgia during a time when the land is marked by conflict and the presence of the Cherokee territories.
